info.title: API.SH: noon
info.description: The noon API from API.SH: public noon data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
One noon product: name, brand, price, rating and count, best-seller rank, breadcrumbs, highlights, description, specifications, images, colour/size/model groups, variants and every seller's offer (price, sale price, stock, express, delivery estimate, warranty, returns, coupon and seller rating), frequently bought together and any newer model.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/noon-product

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
noon search or category listing (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt): SKU, name, brand, link, price, regular and sale price, discount, rating and count, stock, express flag, deal, coupon, best-seller rank, seller with rating, key specs and images, with brand, price, express and any facet filter, and sorts. Also every facet with values and counts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/noon-search

parameters.name: express
parameters.description: true for items fulfilled by noon (express) only.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Other facets as code:value,value; separated by semicolons, e.g. colour_family:black;mobile_storage:256gb.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

products.name: iPhone 17 256GB (Nano SIM + eSIM) Sage 5G  With FaceTime - International Version
iPhone 17 Pro Max 256 GB (eSIM only) Silver 5G With FaceTime - Middle East Version

get.description:
A noon seller's store in one country: the seller (code, name, rating, rating count, positive share, link) and the products it sells, with the same fields, filters (brand, price range, express, any facet), sort, paging and facets as /noon/v1/search. The seller code is `offers[].seller.code` in /noon/v1/product. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/noon-seller

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: Seller code (e.g. p-16024) or the store link noon.com/uae-en/p-16024/ in `url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
